name: Limited Interval CFG Guider (cgem156)
plain: Guider setting cfg to 1 outside a noise range. Its start and end inputs are fractions passed through the model's percent_to_sigma, despite the 'step' names. It does not look at the sample sigmas.
math: s_t = s if σ(end)<σ≤σ(start) else 1, σ(p)=percent_to_sigma(p).

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: Window [0, ratio] by ComfyUI percent (default ratio 0.25); x̂_c after it, with the uncond pass dropped there.

label: from code

audit.note: No step index or sample sigmas are used. limited_interval_cfg_guider.py:12-13,44-50: start_step and end_step are floats in 0..1, converted by model_sampling.percent_to_sigma, and the guider tests σ_end<σ≤σ_start.
